documents.text: Professional experience includes maintaining customer-facing business applications, reviewing production incidents, renewing service certificates, improving automated tests, documenting delivery procedures, and collaborating with engineering and compliance teams. At KLx and LCL, the candidate implemented the European Union Instant Payments and Verification of Payee regulation to support regulatory compliance. The candidate also maintained legacy applications critical to customers' daily operations. Other achievements include developing REST APIs, improving batch-processing simulations, contributing code reviews, supporting continuous integration pipelines, and maintaining developer documentation. In the NevGiU HR AI Recruitment Manager project, the candidate used Angular 19, TypeScript, Bootstrap, Spring Boot 3.5, Java 21, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Redis, Docker Compose, Caddy, and GitHub Actions. Additional project work covered unit and integration testing, application security, deployment automation, and open-source maintenance.
The candidate holds the Spring Certified Professional 2023 certification and has professional Java and Spring Boot experience.
